good consultation time for my kitten.

Great service as always.  Beechwood Vets recognise our pets are our family and treat them with massive respect.  Respect to the staff at Beechwood Vets. Thank you
So friendly, caring and supportive
Always a great, friendly service from all the staff in Garforth. Would highly recommend.

Came today to say good by to our special  boy my shitzu  becky amazing  full of compassion. Hi trust becky will have looked after him so well   thaankyu to all the staff for looking after toby in the past. Too xxxxx

I would like to thank everyone who took care of Benji but especially Anja, Lauren and Angie. He was such a wonderful, happy and loving boy and I miss him so much. Thank you for your cards and seeds. Xx

Always really friendly and happy to listen about any concerns or general updates on your pet. Very helpful and not judgemental when our cat has put on a few pounds. Always really clean environment and quiet which is perfect for a cat too.

Took my cat of 15yrs to garforth clinic and the service was excellent from walking in the door to leaving.been with beechwood for many years but this time my cat had a good check up and given medication he needs,no hard sell of anything and very happy with how much the whole visit cost.
Thankyou beechwood
Very caring and friendly vets
Would highly recomend Beechwood vets ,the vets are amazing, great customer service, receptionists are so helpful  wouldnt go anywhere else with our pets 😄 they go above 100% …
Nice rejuvinated premises, very friendly and efficient vets, couldn't be more happy with the way my cat was treated. No pressure selling of expensive "extras" either, well done Beechwod vets.
Really friendly team of admin and vets, they seem to know your pet when you walk in, and understanding and caring
Our dog can be very anxious around people. All the staff were brilliant with him and helped keep him calm. He really enjoyed his treats!
Really friendly and kind, everyone there. Nice to talk to the team, genuinely caring and interactive with our dog Della, who is very nervous.
Very friendly staff and Vets and modern premises

Visited for our dogs annual check up and booster. He’s a very nervous and anxious schnauzer but the vet we saw was amazing with him. We’ve been coming to Beechwood for 3 years and this was the best visit we’ve had yet. Really personable and caring. Love the new look at garforth too.
The vets and all staff at both Garforth and Seacroft have been so good with our very nervous border collie. They make our visits so calm and are very patient and kind with Charlie.

Been using this vets for quite a few years, they’ve always been helpful and professional. Yesterday James went the extra mile, we visited for vaccinations for our two dogs, but when I booked the apt. I explained there were a few worrying …
Took new pup for vaccines. She was greeted by both on reception and petted. Helped me with her chip and change of ownership etc. Excellent service.
